app.name: bamboo
app.description: Manage your private mesh network from one console.

landing.title: bamboo
landing.subtitle: Sign in to manage your mesh.
landing.selfHosted: Running self-hosted? Use a pre-auth key in the CLI.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Peers, policy, and recent activity across your tailnet.

peers.title: Peers
peers.subtitle: Every device on your tailnet and its MagicDNS name.

newPeer.formHint: Mint a pre-auth key. Paste it into the bamboo client on the new device to connect.
newPeer.reusableHint: Default: one-time. Reusable keys can connect multiple devices and are useful for bulk-rollout but harder to rotate.
newPeer.autoApproveHint: Default: off — every first-time device lands in the admin Pending queue. Tick this for CI / kiosk fleets that should skip the manual approval click.
newPeer.resultHint: The pre-auth key below is shown only once. Copy it now — the controller stores only a hash and cannot recover the plaintext.
newPeer.qrHint: Scan with the bamboo iOS / macOS app to autofill all three fields.
newPeer.oneShotWarning: If you lose this key, mint a new one — there's no way to retrieve it.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# pending device} other {# pending devices}}
pending.subtitle: Admin must approve before they join the mesh

rowMenu.confirmDelete: Delete this peer? This cannot be undone.

peers.empty: No peers yet. Run bamboo up on a machine to register the first peer.

drawer.notFound: Peer not found. It may have been deleted, or the URL contains a stale id.
drawer.fetchError: Failed to load peer details. Try refreshing the page in a moment.

advertise.routesHint: This peer is offering to route the following CIDRs. Approve the ones you trust — other peers' allowed_ips merge in only what you approve.

routeConflicts.summary: {count, plural, one {# conflict with another peer} other {# conflicts with other peers}}

kind.duplicate: Same CIDR also approved on {host} ({cidr}) — WireGuard picks one peer arbitrarily; the other's traffic is dropped.
kind.contains: Overlaps {host}'s narrower {cidr} — traffic to that range routes through {host}, not this peer.
kind.contained_by: Inside {host}'s broader {cidr} — traffic outside this range routes through {host} instead.

actions.confirmDelete: Delete this peer? This cannot be undone.

empty.connectionTimeline: No path transitions in the last 24 hours — connection has been steady.
empty.bandwidth: No bandwidth samples yet. Clients on a version that supports bandwidth reporting will populate this section after their next heartbeat.

preAuthKeys.title: Pre-auth keys
preAuthKeys.subtitle: Admin-issued keys you paste into a bamboo client on a new device for its first connection. The plaintext is shown once at mint time; afterward only revocation is possible.
preAuthKeys.empty: No pre-auth keys yet. Go to Peers → Add peer to mint one.

acl.title: Access Policy
acl.empty: No access policy is configured. New tenants start with allow-all; tighten before going to production.

editor.staleRevision: Another admin just updated the policy. Cancel, refresh the page, then merge your changes.

preview.descDraft: Simulate the draft policy against currently-approved peers to see who can reach whom.
preview.descSaved: Simulate the saved policy against currently-approved peers to see who can reach whom.
preview.idle: Click "Run simulation" to see the allow / deny matrix.
preview.emptyPeers: No approved peers to simulate. Approve at least two devices on the Peers page first.

versions.description: History is shown newest-first. Rolling back applies an older revision as a NEW current revision (the audit trail keeps both).
versions.rollbackSameAsCurrent: Same content as current — nothing to roll back

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People currently in this tenant. New members are created automatically on first OIDC sign-in; invite and role-management flows are planned but not yet shipped.
users.empty: No users yet. The first account to sign in via OIDC becomes admin.

newInvite.formHint: Creates an invitation record. A one-time token is generated on submit; the redeem flow is still in progress, so hold off on sharing the token until that PR lands.
newInvite.isAdminHint: Admins can invite members, manage ACL, and revoke keys. Default is regular member.
newInvite.errorDuplicate: An active invitation already exists for this email. Revoke the existing one first.
newInvite.resultHint: The invitation token below is shown only once.
newInvite.resultHintEmailed: Invitation email sent to {email}. The token below is a backup — share manually only if needed.
newInvite.oneShotWarning: If you lose this token, revoke the invitation and create a new one — there's no way to retrieve it.
newInvite.redeemPendingWarning: ⚠ Redeem flow is not yet shipped — the invitee can't use this token to sign up yet. Wait for the accept-flow PR before sharing.
newInvite.emailNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured, so no email was sent. Copy the token below and share it with the invitee manually.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.empty: No invitations yet. Click "Invite user" above to create the first.

dns.title: DNS

empty.title: MagicDNS not configured yet
empty.body: Once enabled, peers can resolve each other by short hostname — e.g. mac-mini.bamboo → 100.64.0.1, no memorizing IPs. The controller auto-derives a DNS-safe label from each peer's hostname on register (migration 00008 onwards).
empty.note: Controller-side PUT/PATCH for DNS config isn't wired in this release. Register a new peer to seed the row, or wait for the upcoming Web settings UI.

dns.subtitle: Manage tenant DNS settings. This view is read-only; updates to MagicDNS and nameservers happen via the controller API today.
dns.magicDnsHint: When on, peers in this tenant resolve each other by short hostname under the tailnet namespace.
dns.nameserversEmpty: Not set — peers fall back to their local DNS.
dns.overrideHint: When on, tenant nameservers replace each peer's local DNS; when off, they're merged.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Recent policy-evaluation traces from peers in this tenant. Allow/deny decisions are recorded with the matching rule so you can audit access in production.
logs.empty: No log events recorded yet. Once peers begin handshaking and exchanging traffic, decisions will appear here.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.subtitle: Long-lived admin tokens for CI runners, Terraform providers, ops scripts. Present the token as Authorization: Bearer bat_… on any /api/v1/* call.
apiTokens.empty: No API tokens yet. Mint one to start automating tenant-admin operations.

form.nameHint: Operator-facing label — shown in the list and the audit log.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What this token is used for
form.expiresHint: Optional. Empty = never expires (rotate via revoke + re-mint).

secretModal.title: API token
secretModal.description: Copy this token now and store it where your automation can read it. It's shown once and the controller doesn't keep a recovery copy.
secretModal.warning: If you lose this token, revoke the row and mint a new one — there's no rotation path.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Outbound HTTP endpoints that receive a signed POST whenever an audited event happens in this tenant. The receiver verifies the X-Bamboo-Signature header (sha256=<hex>) against the raw request body using the subscription secret.
webhooks.empty: No webhook subscriptions yet. Add one to start receiving event deliveries.

form.urlHint: Must start with http:// or https://. Self-hosted internal endpoints are accepted.
form.eventTypesHint: Comma-separated. Empty = all events. Use exact actions (peer.register) or prefix.+dot (peer.) to match every sub-action.

test.non2xx: Receiver returned {status} — verify endpoint accepts the payload

secretModal.title: Webhook secret
secretModal.description: Copy this secret now and store it next to your receiver's verification config. It's shown once and the controller doesn't keep a recovery copy.
secretModal.warning: If you lose this secret, delete the subscription and create a new one — there's no rotation path.

relays.title: Relay servers
relays.subtitle: Shared infrastructure that forwards WireGuard packets for peers behind symmetric NAT. The controller probes each relay's /healthz every 30 seconds; relays marked unhealthy are hidden from the relay list clients receive on register.
relays.empty: No relays registered yet. Add one via POST /api/v1/admin/relays (create form coming in a follow-up).

preAuthKeysCard.title: Pre-auth keys
preAuthKeysCard.description: Mint and revoke the keys that new devices paste into their bamboo client on first connection.

webhooksCard.title: Webhooks
webhooksCard.description: Outbound HTTP endpoints that receive a signed POST whenever an audited event happens in this tenant.

apiTokensCard.title: API tokens
apiTokensCard.description: Long-lived admin tokens for CI / Terraform / ops scripts. Presented as Authorization: Bearer bat_… on any /api/v1/* call.

relaysCard.title: Relay servers
relaysCard.description: Shared infrastructure that forwards WireGuard packets for peers behind symmetric NAT. The controller probes each one every 30s and flags unreachable ones.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.subtitle: An admin invited you to a bamboo tenant. Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to; the system will accept the invitation and create your account automatically.

tokenMissing.title: Missing invite token
tokenMissing.body: This link doesn't include a ?token parameter. Ask the admin for the full invite link.

invite.emailHint: Sign in with the same email the invite was issued to — anything else is rejected.
invite.expiryHint: Invitations expire. Ask the admin to re-issue if the link no longer works.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.body: This page needs an authenticated session. Sign in with the identity provider configured for your tenant.

forbidden.title: Admin access required
forbidden.body: Your account doesn't have permission to view this page. Ask a tenant admin to grant you the role.

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the controller
unreachable.body: The controller didn't respond. Check your connection, then try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The resource is gone, or the URL is stale.
